title: Hymn to the Supreme Creator (Mynsiem Bakhuid, Ko Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw)
khasi_title: Mynsiem Bakhuid, Ko Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw
composer: Classical Khasi Sacred Hymnody (LB 168 / Seng Khasi)
cultural_context: Foundational indigenous spiritual hymn invoking U Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw (God the Creator, Organizer, and Architect of Creation). Celebrates divine light (jingshai), purification of conscience, the moral principle of tip-briew tip-blei (to know humanity is to know God), and prayers for peace across all ancestral climes.
lyrics_khasi:
Mynsiem Bakhuid, ko Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw,
Wan ban shongsah bad ki khun batlot bor;
Theh sbun ha ngi jing-aiei jingkyrkhu,
Thaw thymmai pat, maramot ia ngi Trai.
To wan ko Trai, wan pynkhlain, wan aibor,
Wan ban hikai, lam ia ngi sha jingshai!

Ko Nongpyntngen b’la kular U Jisu,
Me long jingai bakordor jong U Kpa;
Me iai thehsei jingai hynniew syrtap,
Ka jingtip-briew jingtip-blei Me pynsan.
To wan ko Trai, wan pynkhlain, wan aibor,
Wan ban hikai, lam ia ngi sha jingshai!

Ko thylliej ding, wan hiar halor jong ngi,
Thang duh ka pop, sait noh ki jingthohbria;
Phrang pat ia ngi ha ka jingieid nylla,
Ba ngin iai long ki khun ba-ieid i’u Kpa.
To wan ko Trai, wan pynkhlain, wan aibor,
Wan ban hikai, lam ia ngi sha jingshai!

Ko Bor a-neng, beh krad i’u ksuid u khrei,
Ia ngi to ai ka jingsuk ba-longblei;
To long ma Me U Nongkdup Nongkynshew,
To lam ma Me ha lynti ka jingim.
To wan ko Trai, wan pynkhlain, wan aibor,
Wan ban hikai, lam ia ngi sha jingshai!

Thymmei jingstad, lam ia ngi ban shemphang,
Ban tip i’u Kpa bad i’u Khun bamarwei,
Lem bad Me ruh, ko Mynsiem jong U Blei,
Burom, ka nam tang ia Me ngin iai tei.
To wan ko Trai, wan pynkhlain, wan aibor,
Wan ban hikai, lam ia ngi sha jingshai!
lyrics_english:
O Holy Spirit, O God Creator and Architect of all,
Come and abide with Thy children frail in strength;
Pour out graciously upon us Thy grace and blessings,
Recreate us anew, restore and renew us, O Lord!
Come, O Lord, come strengthen and impart power,
Come teach and lead us into the divine light!

O Comforter promised through divine grace,
Thou art the most precious gift of the Father;
Continually pouring forth sevenfold heavenly gifts,
Nurturing within us the knowledge of God and humanity.
Come, O Lord, come strengthen and impart power,
Come teach and lead us into the divine light!

O tongue of fire, descend upon our midst,
Burn away every blemish, cleanse all defilement;
Refine us once more in genuine, purest love,
That we may ever remain cherished children of the Father.
Come, O Lord, come strengthen and impart power,
Come teach and lead us into the divine light!

O Heavenly Power, drive far away all evil and discord,
Grant unto us divine tranquility and peace;
Be Thou our sheltering Guardian and divine Sustainer,
Guide our footsteps along the straight path of life.
Come, O Lord, come strengthen and impart power,
Come teach and lead us into the divine light!

O Fountainhead of wisdom, enlighten our understanding,
To know the eternal Creator in truth and purity,
Together with Thee, O Holy Spirit of God,
Honor and glory to Thy name alone shall we ever raise!
Come, O Lord, come strengthen and impart power,
Come teach and lead us into the divine light!

stanzas.title: Ka Jingkyrpad ia U Nongthaw (Supplication to the Creator)
stanzas.khasi:
Mynsiem Bakhuid, ko Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw,
Wan ban shongsah bad ki khun batlot bor;
Theh sbun ha ngi jing-aiei jingkyrkhu,
Thaw thymmai pat, maramot ia ngi Trai.
stanzas.english: O Holy Spirit, God the Creator, come abide with Thy children of little strength; pour grace and blessing, recreate and renew us, O Lord!

stanzas.title: Ka Jingtip-Briew Jingtip-Blei (Moral Consciousness)
stanzas.khasi:
Ko Nongpyntngen b’la kular U Jisu,
Me long jingai bakordor jong U Kpa;
Me iai thehsei jingai hynniew syrtap,
Ka jingtip-briew jingtip-blei Me pynsan.
stanzas.english: O Promised Comforter, Father's precious gift; pouring forth sevenfold gifts, nurturing moral consciousness and knowledge of God and man.

stanzas.title: Ka Ding Bakhuid (The Cleansing Flame)
stanzas.khasi:
Ko thylliej ding, wan hiar halor jong ngi,
Thang duh ka pop, sait noh ki jingthohbria;
Phrang pat ia ngi ha ka jingieid nylla,
Ba ngin iai long ki khun ba-ieid i’u Kpa.
stanzas.english: O tongue of fire descend, burn away fault and wash all stain; refine us in purest love that we may remain beloved children.

stanzas.title: Ka Bor Aneng (Heavenly Defense)
stanzas.khasi:
Ko Bor a-neng, beh krad i’u ksuid u khrei,
Ia ngi to ai ka jingsuk ba-longblei;
To long ma Me U Nongkdup Nongkynshew,
To lam ma Me ha lynti ka jingim.
stanzas.english: O Power above, cast out evil, grant divine peace; be our protector and treasure, lead us on the path of life.

stanzas.title: Thymmei Jingstad (Fount of Wisdom)
stanzas.khasi:
Thymmei jingstad, lam ia ngi ban shemphang,
Ban tip i’u Kpa bad i’u Khun bamarwei,
Lem bad Me ruh, ko Mynsiem jong U Blei,
Burom, ka nam tang ia Me ngin iai tei.
stanzas.english: Fount of wisdom, grant us discernment to know the Creator; with Thee, Spirit of God, honor and glory we raise to Thee alone.

vocabulary.nongbuh nongthaw: The Supreme Deity as sovereign framer, disposer, and architect of the universe
vocabulary.tip-briew tip-blei: Core Khasi ethical maxim: to know man is to know God; moral responsibility towards humanity
vocabulary.nylla: Pure, unadulterated, unalloyed (e.g. jingieid nylla = genuine unselfish love)
vocabulary.thylliej ding: Tongue of fire; purifying celestial flame
vocabulary.syrtap: Fold, layer, tier (e.g. hynniew syrtap = sevenfold celestial layers)
vocabulary.jingthohbria: Moral blemish, character spot, spiritual stain
vocabulary.bor aneng: Celestial authority; divine power emanating from the heavenly heights
